title: No Drop Is Unhappy to Reach the Ocean
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah `Azeez Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah Kareem Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sulta•n Allah!
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
Yaa RijaalAllah. Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `ala Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa’l-Akhireen, Sayyidina Muhammad (s).
(Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.) Thumma 's-salaamu `alaykum yaa Anbiyaaullah, As-salaamu `alayka yaa
awliyaaullah! As-salaamu `alaykum, yaa Saahibu ‘l-Waqt. As-salaamu `alaykum, yaa Saahibu z`-Zamaan,
yaa Saahibu ‘l-Imdaad, yaa Qutbu`l-Aqtaab, yaa Mutasarrifu `alaa wajhihi `l-ard wa tahtahoo wa fawqah. Assalaamu `alaykum, yaa `ibaadAllahi 's-Saliheen. As-salaamu `alaykum yaa Mu'mineen. As-salaamu
`alaykum yaa hadireen. As-salaamu `alaykum yaa gha`ibeen. As-salaamu `alaykum yaa ahlu haadhihi `ddunya, as-salaamu `alaykum man qubbar fee maqaabiri `l-Muslimeen. Allah yufarrij `anhum, karbahu, wa
hammahum fi `d-dunya wa fi `l -akhirah. Dastoor, yaa RijaalAllah.

O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum and welcome! We are asking all believers to be in a good position,
here and Hereafter. And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'rRaheem. We are weak ones; therefore, Allah Almighty is granting us to say, bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem.
There are endless Power Oceans in bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem, and never-ending heavenly blessings
come on people when they are saying, bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. Allah, Allah. SubhaanAllah,
Sultaan Allah. Madad.
O People! We are weak ones, and we are not claiming we are powerful ones. Don't think that technology is
giving to you power, no. Everything on Earth is in Weakness Oceans. Everything is trembling, and if no
heavenly support is coming, even atoms can't be in existence; they are looking for heavenly support to be in
existence. Only Mankind are heedless ones, because they are looking to only what is in front of their eyes and
they are thinking that such instruments are giving them power, no! Allah, Allah. SubhaanAllah.
O People! This world is running on its last station. For every beginning there must be an ending, and this
dunya is running to its last point. When that last point arrives, dunya will disappear in the Power Oceans of
Allah Almighty! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.) O our Lord! Forgive us and give us a chance for
understanding that yesterday we were coming in existence and tomorrow we are going to disappear. Our
appearance is a show. Don't think that today was a copy from yesterday, no! And you must not think that
tomorrow is coming to be just a copy for today, no! Everything is changing; running to its last station, and for
everything there is a last station. This is a material world that will end in a heavenly station, and when
reaching that station then appearances on this world are finished.
O People! You must think on something. Allah (swt) granted to Mankind a heavenly condition for
understanding, that our thinking is not from the material world, but it is from unseen worlds that we are
saying "heavens." It is coming from there. If it is cut off, then just finished. And what you understand from
this life is going with you and that is what belongs to heavens; it does not belong to this material, or physical
world, no. This is just finishing, and everything is leaving and every living one must be taken away. One day it
is going to be nothing! When we are going to be nothing, when heavenly power that is supporting our lives
here is taken back, that means we are going to be dust. Only what is necessary for Mankind (remains),
because the Lord of Heavens is never creating anything for nothing, or to be nothing! Everyone has been

granted by Allah Almighty's creating, and every one's existence is different from the second one. Even one
atom's creation and its position in this existence is different from another atom. Therefore, they are naming
so many elements and each element is reaching its smallest piece of its beginning, and they have been
granted something in this existence. When it is taken away that means it has been taken away from this
material world and reaching to an unknown ocean, where they were granted something when they came in
this life.
People think, "We are something coming accidentally, leaving accidentally, and going accidentally." They
think the real position for Mankind to be on this planet is so easy, coming and going. They are never thinking,
“Who is asking Man to be on this planet? How are we going to be on this planet? Who granted that existence
to us? One day our physical being is falling down and no one can be able to make a falling one to stand up
again." If they were to use all possibilities they were granted from the Lord of Heavens for a person whose
existence is finishing and falling down, and it is like a rock, nothing can be done for him. And people are
saying, "What happened?" They are not thinking how a person came into existence and then leave that
existence and run away. They are looking at their dead body, saying, "What?" And everyone will look at their
dead body one day and say, "This is my body? My dead body is so ugly. I am never asking to coming back to
that rotten body!" and running away. Therefore, no one's soul is asking to reenter it's body once again,
saying, "Ohh! We are thankful to our Lord that an opportunity is opening to run away. Now I am so light.
Why would I ask to come back?" Therefore, who is passing away, no one is asking it come back to be in that
body, which is created from four elements. Each element is saying, "Ohh! We are now free from carrying that
one's heavy burden. We must come back to our real position and will be quickly running to be dust in the
Earth."
O People! That day is near; individually or commonly, it is coming. Everyone will leave and the Earth will say,
"Ohhh! I am so light! I am so happy that there is no one from those who were running on me, that I was
carrying on my shoulders! Just they left me and ran to a direction that I am never knowing. But I am free now
from carrying that one, particularly those dirty ones! I am happy that I am returning to my real situation."
Days are running! Man is running! Running for what? Running to catch what is running away from them. It
is impossible; no, finished! And we are living on a planet whose destination is coming closer and looking,
"When am I going to be free from creatures and be by myself?"

But people are not asking to be their real being and therefore, Mankind is unhappy. They are never going to
be in rest or enjoyment or in satisfaction, because they are not finding what they are asking, to rest. Those
people who have a chance to find their real positions, their last station, but who were heedless from that
limit, are asking to come back, but it is impossible. Only those who were thinking for their last station are
finding it and resting. Physical resting just happened through death, but they will reach real pleasure when
they leave their material being, when they reach that ocean. They will be happy there and in satisfaction, and
not in need of anything (they will have everything)! That ocean they are running in is such an ocean that no
one can understand until they reach it.
O People! Don't waste your lives, but try to be awakened and to look at when we are going to be free from this
life! People are never saying, "We are bound in chains," but rather, "We are living!" Life is tying them, but
when it approaches the end they become sorry and say, "No! We are leaving a sweet life and we don't know
where we are going!" They never understand the sweetness for their souls! Rain is coming like drops, and no
drop is going to be unhappy because it is reaching the ocean. Perhaps every drop is asking to reach that ocean
of reality, the ocean of real life. You can find in that ocean every reality that you do not understand in this life.
You may reach a pleasure that you never tasted in your whole life! May Allah forgive us.
O People! Say 100 times daily, laa ilaaha illa-Llah Sayyidina Muhammadan Rasoolullah. (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.) You will
be happy. If you are asking for more, say 100 times, bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. You will reach a level
where you can understand something coming for days in this life. May Allah forgive us. If you are
understanding, no one is expecting that there are such endless Beauty Oceans, endless Favor Oceans, because
they are not expecting endless enjoyment and endless happiness! Therefore, people are coming down,
approaching, and rising up in their imaginations, making themselves to fall down, fall down, fall down, and
every level is going to be darker, more terrible and more disturbing to people.
O People! Try to be with Allah Almighty's endless Blessing Oceans, for the honor of His most beloved one in
His Divine Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits.)
Fatihah.
